、极其过分而破"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"3a85737bfad4c282b0a34368b0006d19","modified":1612428947346,"text":"1、比喻不成立"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"LBqRdUJCvY","modified":1612428947346,"text":"此生若未生，云何能自生？"},{"color":"","id":"JSQ31pX7qO","modified":1612428947346,"text":"若生已自生，生已何用生？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"TuhIN9UJCd","modified":1612428947346,"text":"1、自生非理"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"CFQqU8NftS","modified":1612428947346,"text":"生非生已生，亦非未生生，"},{"color":"","id":"PnQUugDzeP","modified":1612428947346,"text":"生时亦不生。去来中已答。"}],"color":"","id":"O86ymQLidj","modified":1612428947346,"text":"1、总破三时生"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"SC8KFRoLx6","modified":1612428947346,"text":"若谓生时生，是事已不成。"},{"color":"","id":"z1EsXRCuNE","modified":1612428947346,"text":"云何依生法，尔时而得生？"}],"color":"","id":"urqAfcgdnE","modified":1612428947346,"text":"2、别破正生生"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"v0gOCoEFiN","modified":1612428947346,"text":"若法众缘生，即是寂灭性。"},{"color":"","id":"589CrDWMUf","modified":1612428947346,"text":"是故生生时，是二俱寂灭。"}],"color":"","id":"fx5DCB6pqg","modified":1612428947346,"text":"1、说缘起空性的合理性"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"8muUvPnqcJ","modified":1612428947346,"text":"若有未生法，说言有生者。"},{"color":"","id":"eK2BVvzHI3","modified":1612428947346,"text":"可生之彼法，不成岂可生？"}],"color":"","id":"2Ax0kP77RA","modified":1612428947346,"text":"2、破未来法的产生存在"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"TGbP5ZToYw","modified":1612428947346,"text":"3、破缘起不合理之说"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"J3i7nah1Wh","modified":1612428947346,"text":"1、观察三时而破"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"MDMWbYDHEf","modified":1612428947346,"text":"若言生时生，是能有所生。"},{"color":"","id":"SsIPh8ScrO","modified":1612428947346,"text":"何得更有生，而能生是生？"}],"color":"","id":"bxspdURPKf","modified":1612428947346,"text":"1、反问"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"R5GNWsFusV","modified":1612428947346,"text":"若谓更有生，生生则无穷。"},{"color":"","id":"egZAUB5pYM","modified":1612428947346,"text":"离生生有生，法皆自能生。"}],"color":"","id":"eaLoUUhx4N","modified":1612428947346,"text":"2、驳斥"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"qnOEgzpGJn","modified":1612428947346,"text":"2、观察生有无其他生而破"}],"color":"","id":"0hPFA8bDJd","modified":1612428947346,"text":"2、他生非理"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"7e882f15d5165fa42d32d850b593a4ea","modified":1612428947346,"text":"2、意义不成立"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"7fc9780b0dd4e1e10edc21cfa391a05c","modified":1612428947346,"text":"2、断除过失"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"c840d3d736b5f045e7422e4ecf6cd540","modified":1612428947346,"text":"2、第二断过"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"0e82220689d81209dfbbd6eb91eec3d6","modified":1612428947346,"text":"2、断除过失"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"e23dffa04bac141bd73efe89401b0383","modified":1612428947346,"text":"3、观察有无其他法相而破"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"0cecff56d3d32da5141c798523210e88","modified":1612428947346,"text":"1、总破"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"cPJeF2sw0q","modified":1612428947346,"text":"有法不应生，无亦不应生，"},{"color":"","id":"Ls8SDc1Iqy","modified":1612428947346,"text":"有无亦不生，此义先已说。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"OtujclyX33","modified":1612428947346,"text":"1、以前理而破"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"hfU5UYMOvM","modified":1612428947346,"text":"若诸法灭时，是时不应生。"},{"color":"","id":"mTQk2JsI71","modified":1612428947346,"text":"法若不灭者，终无有是事。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"mo2uNxuB3q","modified":1612428947346,"text":"2、观察是否正灭而破"}],"color":"","id":"2cEckZGylU","modified":1612428947346,"text":"1、破生"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"Zz4RItBNlu","modified":1612428947346,"text":"不住法不住，住法亦不住，"},{"color":"","id":"58Jo5OCU1f","modified":1612428947346,"text":"住时亦不住，无生云何住？"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"aGipleVdxd","modified":1612428947346,"text":"1、观察三时而破"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"bJdy5bE8mI","modified":1612428947346,"text":"若诸法灭时，是则不应住；"},{"color":"","id":"VZuA0lpbcL","modified":1612428947346,"text":"法若不灭者，终无有是事。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"maVpVXyEgk","modified":1612428947346,"text":"2、观察是否正灭而破"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"iWiTVUeSSn","modified":1612428947346,"text":"所有一切法，皆是老死相。"},{"color":"","id":"Z9G4Hz3CFJ","modified":1612428947346,"text":"终不见有法，离老死有住。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"mNwCwPEiq6","modified":1612428947346,"text":"3、抉择诸法不离老死相而破"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"S64ATyzFxr","modified":1612428947346,"text":"住不自相住，亦不异相住。"},{"color":"","id":"MpOq3O8NvY","modified":1612428947346,"text":"如生不自生，亦不异相生。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"tj9RCbrNMY","modified":1612428947346,"text":"4、观察以自住他住而破"}],"color":"","id":"yLkvjg1c7N","modified":1612428947346,"text":"2、破住"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"ucrCPiwlpm","modified":1612428947346,"text":"法已灭不灭，未灭亦不灭，"},{"color":"","id":"DRZ9EvjIez","modified":1612428947346,"text":"灭时亦不灭，无生何有灭?"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"jVp1GgwskY","modified":1612428947346,"text":"1、观察三时而破"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"igmskEIkWx","modified":1612428947346,"text":"若法有住者，是则不应灭；"},{"color":"","id":"yl6LeZBXnZ","modified":1612428947346,"text":"法若不住者，是亦不应灭。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"MP9t9lEpQy","modified":1612428947346,"text":"2、观察住不住而破"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"Xw4NBNLeVy","modified":1612428947346,"text":"是法于是时，不于是时灭；"},{"color":"","id":"scmuAyGTg6","modified":1612428947346,"text":"是法于异时，不于异时灭。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"KeVEjd2Nlu","modified":1612428947346,"text":"3、观察因果而破"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"WXa43H4jGp","modified":1612428947346,"text":"如一切诸法，生相不可得。"},{"color":"","id":"L4Kt6T8Dj8","modified":1612428947346,"text":"以无生相故，即亦无灭相。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"DrT9t6HH7N","modified":1612428947346,"text":"4、观察能遍不可得而破"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"2chjxca2YW","modified":1612428947346,"text":"若法是有者，是即无有灭。"},{"color":"","id":"HAO9tDILDp","modified":1612428947346,"text":"不应于一法，而有有无相。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"rFHqK5pgaN","modified":1612428947346,"text":"1、有实不可灭"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"DYVHpwKzj0","modified":1612428947346,"text":"若法是无者，是则无有灭。"},{"color":"","id":"Yqu2WK7J7U","modified":1612428947346,"text":"譬如第二头，无故不可断。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"T6yYe9VS3T","modified":1612428947346,"text":"2、无实不可灭"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"7lO4ht6wlG","modified":1612428947346,"text":"5、观察有实无实而破"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"we0fGEsjr7","modified":1612428947346,"text":"法不自相灭，他相亦不灭，"},{"color":"","id":"EAtXOnKc9M","modified":1612428947346,"text":"如自相不生，他相亦不生。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"8xll4LvLlC","modified":1612428947346,"text":"6、观察自灭他灭而破"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"gYlL2FveeD","modified":1612428947346,"text":"3、破灭"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"1069b13ee43016dd8cbc6a0f8ac9e00d","modified":1612428947346,"text":"2、别破"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"c8dafcad5aaf1c5405c0e6c14a97f04b","modified":1612428947346,"text":"1、破生住灭三法相"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"3AVI2sx88b","modified":1612428947346,"text":"生住灭不成，故无有有为。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"3aa18037432ec0b41defba1b7a3233cb","modified":1612428947346,"text":"2、以此能破事相有为法"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"9eadf36b422d1b474c0bc7c47828e2f1","modified":1612428947346,"text":"1、遮破有为法"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"klJ4ATQEXY","modified":1612428947346,"text":"有为法无故，何得有无为？"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"293d100cef8b09ed0583b17074810802","modified":1612428947346,"text":"2、遮破无为法"},{"children":[{"color":"","id":"f48cHlk2Ot","modified":1612428947346,"text":"如幻亦如梦，如乾闼婆城。"},{"color":"","id":"dvCA5wm7XZ","modified":1612428947346,"text":"所说生住灭，其相亦如是。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"a8ae542dd52335f9b3cea00d892a99b6","modified":1612428947346,"text":"3、遮止与圣教相违"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"bf70d2f9ee0ef9a472ddcb3eba0c25d1","modified":1612428947346,"text":"1、以理证广说"},{"id":"68095da52c33d091ef66c67feb3cdd01","modified":1612428947346,"text":"2、以教证总结"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#ffaf38","heading":0,"id":
